method: Hand-authored expected captions in Florence-2 style, grounded in the published HoloAssist timeline in data/real/holoassist_switch_34s.json, the interaction strips in runs/real_clips/, and nearby rest/hold frames in the clip. These are labels, not model output; no caption was taken from or invented as a Florence-2 result.
notes: Each published timeline event (grab/hold/slide/place/insert/withdraw/align) has one label; scene, rest, adjust and pre-grasp rows are extra negatives so false positives are measured. Captions may paraphrase the published event string; the timestamp and event field keep each label traceable. Movement-only published rows are represented as OTHER rather than dropped.

labels.caption: A first-person view of the work table and the Joy-Con controllers.
The hand reaches toward the Joy-Con but does not grasp it.
The left hand grabs the blue Joy-Con controller from the work table.
The hand lifts the left Joy-Con off the work table.
The left hand rests on the work table beside the console.
The right hand grabs the comfort grip from the tabletop.
The hand holds the comfort grip above the work table.
The right hand holds the comfort grip steady.
The hand adjusts the comfort grip on the table.
The hand pushes the left Joy-Con forward on the work table.
The hand places the Joy-Con down on the work table.
The hand inserts the left Joy-Con into the rail of the Switch console.
The hand pulls the right Joy-Con out of the console rail.
The hand holds the assembled controller steady.
The hand places the assembled controller onto the tabletop.
The hand aligns the Joy-Con with the rail before inserting it.
The right hand pushes the Joy-Con down the rail of the console.
The hand pulls the Joy-Con out of the console.
The hand sets the right Joy-Con on the table.
